newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's BCH powers ahead before 96 results.
newsitem.headline: Spain's BCH powers ahead before 96 results.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Banco Central Hispano (BCH) jumped almost three percent on Thursday, ahead of its 1996 results, due for release after the close.
"We're expecting very good results, maybe even better than initial forecasts," a dealer in Madrid said.
The shares may add another 200 pesetas in two days, he said.
At around 1200 GMT BCH shares were trading 95 pesetas higher at 3,435 pesetas, up 2.84 percent while the Ibex-35 was up just 0.14 percent to 5,287.50.
A Reuter poll showed 1996 results could climb 168 percent to 33.39 billion pesetas, with operating income at 100.76 billion pesetas up from 94.78 billion in 1995.
"We are expecting net of above 33 billion," one dealer said.
The market also anticipates the figures to be of high quality.
"We see a strong jump in operating income, around 23.1 percent," a dealer said.
